_note: C4 same-regime noise-floor re-run (pre-op packet docs/handoffs/2026-08-16-c4-noise-floor-preop-packet.md): the reader false-event rate at the classification event definition, measured on ground-truth-quiet spans of the committed anis-star (Anis: Star) solo series, with the swha (snow-white-heavy-arms) solo trace as the descriptive-only secondary basis. MEASUREMENT ONLY — parameters, per-span tables, per-source + pooled statistics, control results, distributions. No verdict; decision-rule application belongs to the /scientific-method driver. Replayed by scripts/tests/probe/noise-solo.test.ts.
swhaPinning: Pixel-free pinning attempt (packet section D-3 / BQ3), method: ammo counter read from the regenerated uncropped full frames (labeled montage of counter crops, t=7.00-11.23, every 30fps frame; counter legible throughout). Decrements observed: 006->005 between t=7.80 and 7.83 (pull 1), 005->004 between t=9.40 and 9.43 (pull 2), 004->003 between t=10.97 and 11.00 (pull 3); the charge-percent display resets to 100 at each decrement, corroborating. RESULT: pull instants ARE pixel-free-pinned, but the credit CLUSTERS are not - each pull's credits unroll as bar-derived steps extending ~1.55s past the fire instant (2 steps, a ~0.64s pause, then the 5-hit 0.20s-spaced volley), and the counter carries one decrement per pull, so cluster-hit timing exists only in the bar trace itself. BQ3 requires pixel-free CREDIT-CLUSTER pinning for pooled entry, and no swha span/guard table was pre-registered (section D-2 covers only the anis-star basis) - swha is therefore descriptive-only; its numbers enter no pooled statistic.
